newsitem.title: FRANCE: BA's TAT flight crews call April 9 strike.
newsitem.headline: BA's TAT flight crews call April 9 strike.

text.p: Unions representing pilots and flight engineers at Air Liberte and TAT European Airlines gave notice of a 48-hour strike starting on April 9, a joint union statement said on Friday.

Five unions have joined in the strike call following a breakdown in talks on pay and conditions in the merger of the two airlines. A spokesman for the Union des Navigants de l'Aviation Civile (UNAC) said the main claim was for a two-day rest period every seven days, and 10 days per month instead of the current 36 hours rest each week set by a 1960 decree.
TAT is a subsidiary of British Airways Plc (BA).

The strike is due to start at 1001 GMT on Wednesday, April 9 and ends at 0959 GMT, Friday April 11, the joint union strike notice said. A general assembly of all flight crews has been called for April 9 at 1200 GMT.
TAT pilots and ground staff staged a 24-hour strike on Good Friday against the group's restructuring plans, forcing the cancellation of about two-thirds of the airline's 180 scheduled flights. pnt
